name: artifact-center-mcp
description: Publish and manage Artifact Center artifacts from Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Authorize, publish, and update release artifacts.
interface.longDescription: Uses an Artifact Center release credential to safely discover publish targets, upload builds, and update release notes or explicitly promote beta builds. Destructive deletion is intentionally unavailable.
defaultPrompt: Check my Artifact Center release authorization.
Upload my completed build as a beta artifact.
Update release notes or promote a beta artifact to stable.
